current_status.final_resting_site: Perseverance Valley, rim of Endeavour Crater

traverse_summary.target_destination: Endeavour Crater rim ancient clay and sulfate strata

Discovery of hematite 'blueberries' and jarosite in Eagle Crater (Sol 10-50)
Purgatory Dune entrapment crisis (Sol 446-484; 5 weeks stuck in sand trap)
Victoria Crater rim and interior cliff examination (Sol 950-1630)

waypoints.activity: Hole-in-one landing in 22m crater; confirmed acidic water past from jarosite and hematite spherules
Descended into 130m crater to analyze Burns Formation sulfate strata
All six wheels buried up to axles in hidden soft drift sand; spent 38 sols testing mockups on Earth to carefully extract rover
waypoints.hazard_warning: CRITICAL ENTRAPMENT - Soft drift sand ripple

waypoints.activity: Arrived at 750m wide crater with 70m vertical promontories (Cape Verde)
Discovered smectite clays in ancient pre-impact Noachian rocks indicating neutral pH water
Crossed 26.219-mile marathon line; examined rich smectite phyllosilicates
Final transmission received before catastrophic planet-encircling dust storm opaque sky tau > 10.8
